episodes.title: The Building Blocks of Math: Sets
episodes.description: Introduce set theory as a way to recognize patterns, organize ideas, and ask precise mathematical questions.

episodes.title: Sets and Subsets
episodes.description: Set theory provides the tools to organize all kinds of people, things, concepts, and ideas into categories within categories.

episodes.title: Set Operations
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss set operations and the ways math and set theory help in creating new, precise ideas.

episodes.title: Visualizing Sets with Venn Diagrams
episodes.description: Visualizing how different sets fit together using a few simple circles is often easier than trying to keep track of the data in our heads.

episodes.title: The Fundamental Counting Principle
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss the fundamental principle of counting and how different cultures innovated counting to fit their own needs.

episodes.title: Permutations and Factorials!
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss how through math, we can make sense of all the possibilities using the concept of permutations.

episodes.title: Combinations: The Math of Picking and Choosing
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss combinations and how this process can cut through big numbers and give us practical answers.

episodes.title: Basic Probability
episodes.description: Explore mathematical probability and methods for describing how likely events are to occur.

episodes.title: Probability Rules
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss rules that will help us find the probability of things happening when we combine events.

episodes.title: Dependent and Independent Probabilities
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss independent, dependent, and conditional probabilities and all the ways outcomes can be influenced by the relationship between events!

episodes.title: Adjusting Your Expectations
episodes.description: Use expected value to compare possible outcomes and understand long-run expectations when making choices.

episodes.title: Data Visualization
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss how we can get the deeper meaning behind data by visualizing the information we have available to us.

episodes.title: Measure of Central Tendency
episodes.description: Use measures of central tendency to interpret large datasets and uncover deeper insights.

episodes.title: Measures of Dispersion
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss measures of dispersion and how this tool can give us more insight into our sets of data.

episodes.title: Theory Theater
episodes.description: Explore standard normal distributions and how they connect statistical data with probability.

episodes.title: Not-so Normal: Non-Standard Normal Distributions
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss Non-Standard Normal Distributions and how we can lean on simpler concepts we already understand to solve more unusual ones.

episodes.title: What do I Owe? - Calculating Interest in Finance
episodes.description: In this episode, we dive into the world of finance and discuss interest and its effect on each of our financial decisions.

episodes.title: How Money Reproduces: Compound Interest
episodes.description: Explore compound interest and how it affects borrowing, saving, and investing.

episodes.title: Compound Interest on Different Timescales
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss compound interest and the ways in which time affects it.

episodes.title: How to Save Money with Annuities
episodes.description: Explore annuity savings, how regular contributions build value, and their role in planning for retirement.

episodes.title: Amortized Loans
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss how amortized loans work and the extra costs that come with it through interest.

episodes.title: Amortized Loans, Down Payments, and Amortization Schedules
episodes.description: Explore amortized loans, down payments, and repayment schedules as tools for tracking borrowing costs.

episodes.title: Changing Units with Dimensional Analysis
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss Dimensional Analysis, a toolkit math provides for dealing with all the different choices of units and conversions.

episodes.title: Finding Your Way Around Perimeter
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss perimeters and the tools that can help us find the distance around any shape.

episodes.title: Tackling Complex Shapes
episodes.description: Explore how calculating area helps us understand and plan for the space objects occupy.

episodes.title: From Soda Cans to Spheres - Surface Areas
episodes.description: Whether it’s painting, constructing, wrapping things or even just designing a soda can, understanding surface areas is essential to designing the world around us.

episodes.title: Cutting the Carbon From Building Blocks - Volumes
episodes.description: Use volume to describe how much space three-dimensional objects occupy.

episodes.title: All About Similar Triangles
episodes.description: We can use triangles to describe spatial relationships all around us, from the way we lay out cities to redesigning attics!

episodes.title: Right Angled Triangles and Pythagoras
episodes.description: Explore right triangles and their relationships to everyday spatial problems.

episodes.title: Trigonometry
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss the world of trigonometry and the mathematical functions it uses to describe the relationship between sides and angles.
